## What changed

Describe the behavior and the task ID it completes.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] Relevant fixture or integration evidence is included
- [ ] User-visible package changes include a changeset
- [ ] Task/progress/session records are updated when a canonical task closes

## Safety and provenance

- [ ] No credentials, private traces, raw runs, or local absolute paths were committed
- [ ] Destructive/path/process behavior has dedicated fail-closed tests, if applicable
- [ ] Substantial coding-agent assistance and the human verification performed are disclosed
- [ ] Commits include `Signed-off-by` (DCO 1.1)
